scenario: A module's content no longer matches the checksum/signature in its trust record; the module must not load, with no warn-and-run path.
when: the harness attempts to load the module at session start

reasons: verification failure on 'secret-scan' — content does not match its trust record
the environment reports the mandatory control backed by this module as unguaranteed
must_not: load the module with a warning
fall back to the previous cached version without its own verification
re-trust automatically because the module previously ran
